newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: China's Zhu guarantees Hong Kong prosperity.
newsitem.headline: China's Zhu guarantees Hong Kong prosperity.

text.p: Chinese vice-premier and economic tsar Zhu Rongji said on Wednesday that Beijing would ensure Hong Kong enjoyed automony and long-term stability and prosperity once it returned to Chinese rule.
The handover of Hong Kong at midnight on June 30 was a major step forward to the great cause of "reunification of the motherland", Zhu told the Australia China Business Council.

"China will unswervingly implement the principle of 'one country, two systems', enforce to the letter the Basic Law of Hong Kong -- ensure that Hong Kong will enjoy a high degree of automony," Zhu said in a speech.
"We have the ability and confidence to ensure long-term stability and prosperity of Hong Kong," he said.
Taiwan, still regarded as a renegade province by Beijiung, voiced doubts on Tuesday about Hong Kong's future economic growth under Chinese rule.
But China has consistently promised Hong Kong's 6.4 million residents that their freewheeling capitalist way of life will be kept intact for 50 years after the handover.
